[h3]The annual Fellow Traveller [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]Publisher Sale[/url] is now on - and to celebrate, FRAMED Collection is 80% off! [/h3]

[h3]We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; [b]Scrabdackle[/b], [b]Wander Stars[/b] and [b]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/b] - read up on each of them below![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575810/Wander_Stars/]Wander Stars[/url]:[/b] Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/]Scrabdackle[/url]:[/b] As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246470/Kulebra_and_the_Souls_of_Limbo/]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/url]:[/b] A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.[/list]So get exploring and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]grab some great narrative games[/url]!

notes.title: Humble’s Australian Bushfire Relief Bundle
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025617/ff45242f72e22f453778e80a7e003983e6ad6fd3.png[/img]

We have partnered with Humble Bundle to raise money for the Australian Bushfire relief efforts. 

The bundle includes 29 games in total including Hacknet, Hacknet Labyrinths, The Stillness of the Wind, Think of the Children and Framed Collection. Join us in aiding the relief efforts by [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/australia-fire-relief]purchasing the bundle here for $25.[/url] 100% of the profits from the bundle will go towards [url=https://www.wires.org.au/]WIRES[/url], [url=https://bushfires.rspca.org.au/]RSPCA Australia[/url], and the [url=https://www.wwf.org.au/get-involved/bushfire-emergency#gs.sudahz]World Wildlife Fund.[/url]

Many of these games were developed in Australia and, as an Australian publisher, the current crisis is very close to home and to our hearts. We hope our bushland and communities affected are able to recover soon. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025617/b4f1f4bd9431276106a59ed6bbe4c53c7218af9b.png[/img]

notes.title: 16 Games Announced for LudoNarraCon
notes.content:
Fellow Traveller presents #LudoNarraCon, hosted right here on Steam on May 10-13. Come celebrate narrative video games from around the world with us!

We’ve announced 16 of the exhibiting games to be featured: Neo Cab, Boyfriend Dungeon, Mutazione, Heaven’s Vault, The Church in the Darkness, Sunless Skies, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine, Beholder, Genesis Noir, and more! Check out the full lineup on ludonarracon.com.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025617/a2ef5d4816ac2233baefc17dc05cd36448125a20.jpg[/img]

An initiative of indie label Fellow Traveller, LudoNarraCon is digital convention that aims to create a platform to showcase and celebrate interesting and innovative narrative games, replicating as many of the aspects and benefits of the physical convention experience as possible within a digital format.

Learn more at ludonarracon.com!

notes.title: Surprise Attack Games is now Fellow Traveller
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25928706/db6b95e8d4668f488883e5105a283d714f68caf7.png[/img]

Today our publisher, Surprise Attack Games, is relaunching as Fellow Traveller.

To celebrate, FRAMED Collection is on sale along with the rest of their catalogue. Check out their publisher sale page for all the details - https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller.

Here’s some more from the team at Fellow Traveller on what the change is all about:

[i]For the past seven years, our journey as a small indie publisher from the shores of Australia has been quite momentous. Today marks the biggest stop on that journey so far. A new name. A new vision. A chance for us to stand up and declare our love for games with something important, something special, something weird to say.

Welcome to Fellow Traveller.

From the dystopian worlds of Hacknet and Orwell, to our upcoming releases including Neo Cab, Genesis Noir and In Other Waters, Fellow Traveller is here to support developers that take a unique approach to narrative in games.

If this sounds like your kind of jam, you can follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller]Steam publisher page[/url], join us in The Traveller's Tavern on [url=https://discord.gg/pm4AE7F]Discord[/url] or sign up to [url=http://eepurl.com/dBN5Kj]our newsletter[/url]

notes.title: FRAMED 2 OST - AVAILABLE ON VINYL!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/d7eba78004b32c9e4cc3436441ccddc2aef3956b.jpg[/img]


Hi All! 

We're very excited to announce that we have been working with iam8bit, to bring the smooth jazz stylings of the FRAMED 2 soundtrack to vinyl!

You can now pre-order it [url=https://store.iam8bit.com/products/framed-2-vinyl-soundtrack?] HERE [/url]

Composed by Adrian Moore, this double-sided edition of FRAMED 2's sultry soundtrack gives you the chance to hear it the way it was meant to be.

To complement the smooth and funky musical cues is an impossibly clever package design by artist Jude Buffum. Interaction with the jacket and inner sleeves provides for a satisfying analog to FRAMED's puzzle mechanic, evoking nothing short of absolute glee! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/1a158c608fcee860bcbcf81b7b1eac7219fa7b5a.png[/img]

notes.title: FRAMED Collection Deluxe Edition Launch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/9cdf55a45d2a113994eb0a1cb5f975cbc6e8276f.jpg[/img]

Hi all,

Due to some issues with the Steam backend, FRAMED Collection Deluxe Edition launched a few hours after the initial launch period. The Deluxe Edition includes the Soundtrack, along with the FRAMED Collection game.

For a limited time we have enabled a pay-the-difference discount for those who bought the standard game at launch, and want to upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to add the soundtrack to their collection.

Thanks for all the support!

notes.title: WE ARE LIVE! FRAMED Collection is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/4e8842b22f351d7eb2c3b5377c7b5517566b34fd.jpg[/img]

Hi there,

We’re so excited that FRAMED Collection has finally launched on Steam (PC, Mac and Linux versions). We’ve been working so hard behind the scenes to make everything right, and to get ready to share our games and world of FRAMED with you.

If you love clever, unique puzzle games, spy adventures, noir aesthetics and jazz fusion soundtracks, then you’ll love FRAMED Collection.

Of course, if you’re reading this because you’ve already bought and played the game, we’d love to hear what you think of it. Be sure to come back and post your thoughts, GIFs, questions and user reviews in the Community Hub; we love hearing from our fans.

You can also find us on Twitter @loveshackers.

Once again, it means a great deal to us to launch FRAMED Collection: we can finally share our creative dreams and labours with you, the fans. Thank you so much for your enthusiasm and support of FRAMED Collection. It means the world to us.

- Loveshack Devs

notes.title: FRAMED Collection gets a release date!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/a7021093b31a4a891e6e91ca355efff5a4d6aad7.jpg[/img]

Hi there, and welcome to our FRAMED Collection community!

We’re very happy to finally announce the release date of May 17 for FRAMED Collection on Steam (PC, Mac and Linux versions). If you love clever, unique puzzle games, spy adventures, noir aesthetics and jazz fusion soundtracks, then be sure to wishlist the game! If you do that, we’ll also be able to let you know about any great ‘launch week’ deals.

Of course, once the game has released, we’d love to hear what you think of it. Be sure to come back and post your thoughts, GIFs, questions and user reviews in the Community Hub; we love hearing from our fans. If you’re on Twitter, come and say, ‘Hey,’ by tweeting @loveshackers.

We’ll post again soon, around the launch of the game. Until then, thanks for checking out FRAMED Collection.

- Loveshack Devs
